description: Retrieval gold for the municipal-website knowledge base in data/knowledge_base (fictional company Northbridge Civic Web). Each query is a typical requirement of a city website RFP; relevant_sources are the files that contain evidence to answer it (labelled by the knowledge-base authors). Relevance is judged per file, not per chunk.

queries.query: The website must conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA and comply with the ADA.
Content editors must be able to schedule content to publish and expire automatically.
Staff should be able to add, edit and move content directly on the front end of the site.
Hidden or deleted pages must not keep appearing in Google search results.
Provide user-friendly vanity URLs that staff can create and organize.
A single calendar where all departments post events and residents can filter by category.
A section to post bids, RFPs and RFQs with addenda and notifications to vendors.
The website must integrate with our parks and recreation registration software.
Residents must be able to reach online utility bill payments from the website.
Hosting must guarantee 99.9% uptime with SSL certificates and daily backups.
Describe your disaster recovery plan and recovery time objective.
Migrate existing content and documents while preserving search engine rankings.
Provide training for city staff on website administration and content updates.
Written documentation and user guides for content editors.
Ongoing technical support with guaranteed response times for critical issues.
Staff must log in with single sign-on through our Microsoft Active Directory.
Role-based permissions and approval workflows so departments manage their own pages.
Provide at least three references from similar municipal website projects.
Provide a proposed project timeline and describe your project management approach.
Describe your design process, including user research and homepage design concepts.
The vendor must carry general liability and cyber liability insurance.
Provide website analytics and regular usage reports.
Send emergency alerts to residents by text message and show an alert banner on the site.
The website must offer translation into multiple languages.
